INSERT INTO xxlge_export_info (SESSION_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARACTER_SET_NAME , ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE3, ATTRIBUTE4, ATTRIBUTE5 , ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8, ATTRIBUTE9, ATTRIBUTE10 , ATTRIBUTE11, ATTRIBUTE12, ATTRIBUTE13, ATTRIBUTE14, ATTRIBUTE15 , ATTRIBUTE16, ATTRIBUTE17, ATTRIBUTE18, ATTRIBUTE19, ATTRIBUTE20 , ATTRIBUTE21, ATTRIBUTE22, ATTRIBUTE23, ATTRIBUTE24, ATTRIBUTE25) WITH normal_ot AS ( -- ========================================== -- LUỒNG 1: XỬ LÝ TĂNG CA THƯỜNG (NORMAL OT) -- ========================================== SELECT r.employee_no, NULL AS request_no, -- Bảng thường không có Request No r.time_and_attendance_date, r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE AS work_type_code, r.overtime_sum_hours, t.check_in_date, t.check_out_date, R.SHIFT_TYPE_CODE, r.early_leave_hours, r.tardy_hours, r.going_out_hours, r.time_attend_input_reason_desc, -- 1. Tính Giờ Bắt Đầu Chuẩn CASE WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 13:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_SD' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 08:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_SN' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 20:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_FN' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 01:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || r.work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS std_start_datetime,
-- 2. Tính Giờ Kết Thúc Chuẩn (để lấy làm mốc cộng giờ OT) CASE WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 18:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_SD' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 12:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_SN' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_FN' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 06:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE IN ('WH', 'PH') THEN (CASE WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_FN' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 01:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || r.work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END + NUMTODSINTERVAL(r.work_hours, 'HOUR')) ELSE (CASE WHEN r.TIME_AND_ATTENDANCE_CODE = 'HL_FN' THEN TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date + 1, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 01:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') ELSE TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(r.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || r.work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END + NUMTODSINTERVAL(r.work_hours + 1, 'HOUR')) END AS std_end_datetime
FROM tb_att_result_n r JOIN tb_att_idcard_acs_time_n t ON r.employee_no = t.employee_no AND r.time_and_attendance_date = t.time_and_attendance_date JOIN tb_att_base_bas_n b ON r.shift_type_code = b.shift_type_code AND r.time_and_attendance_date = b.time_and_attendance_date WHERE r.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{atendanceStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND r.overtime_sum_hours > 0 ), normal_ot_target AS ( SELECT 'NORMAL' AS OT_SOURCE, request_no, employee_no, time_and_attendance_date, work_type_code, SHIFT_TYPE_CODE, early_leave_hours, tardy_hours, going_out_hours, time_attend_input_reason_desc, overtime_sum_hours, check_in_date, check_out_date, std_start_datetime, (std_end_datetime + NUMTODSINTERVAL(overtime_sum_hours, 'HOUR')) AS expected_ot_end_time, GREATEST(0, CAST(std_start_datetime AS DATE) - CAST(check_in_date AS DATE)) AS early_arrival_duration FROM normal_ot -- Lọc vi phạm: Mốc End Chuẩn + OT > Giờ về thực tế + Phút đến sớm bù trừ WHERE CAST((std_end_datetime + NUMTODSINTERVAL(overtime_sum_hours, 'HOUR')) AS DATE) > (CAST(check_out_date AS DATE) + GREATEST(0, CAST(std_start_datetime AS DATE) - CAST(check_in_date AS DATE))) ),
special_ot AS ( -- ========================================== -- LUỒNG 2: XỬ LÝ TĂNG CA ĐẶC BIỆT (SPECIAL OT) -- ========================================== SELECT sot.REQUEST_NO AS request_no, sot.employee_no, sot.time_and_attendance_date, sot.SPECIAL_WORK_TYPE_CODE AS work_type_code, '' as SHIFT_TYPE_CODE, 0 as early_leave_hours, 0 as tardy_hours, 0 as going_out_hours, sot.time_attend_input_reason_desc, NVL(sot.overtime_sum_hours, 0) AS overtime_sum_hours, t.check_in_date, t.check_out_date, TO_TIMESTAMP(TO_CHAR(sot.time_and_attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' ' || sot.work_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS std_start_datetime
FROM tb_att_special_ot_result_n sot JOIN tb_att_idcard_acs_time_n t ON sot.employee_no = t.employee_no AND sot.time_and_attendance_date = t.time_and_attendance_date WHERE sot.time_and_attendance_date BETWEEN to_date(#{atendanceStartDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND to_date(#{atendanceEndDate}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND sot.overtime_sum_hours > 0 AND (sot.confirm_flag = 'R' or PROGRESS_STATUS_CODE = '40') ), special_ot_target AS ( SELECT 'SPECIAL' AS OT_SOURCE, request_no, employee_no, time_and_attendance_date, work_type_code, SHIFT_TYPE_CODE, early_leave_hours, tardy_hours, going_out_hours, time_attend_input_reason_desc, overtime_sum_hours, check_in_date, check_out_date, std_start_datetime, (std_start_datetime + NUMTODSINTERVAL(overtime_sum_hours, 'HOUR')) AS expected_ot_end_time, GREATEST(0, CAST(std_start_datetime AS DATE) - CAST(check_in_date AS DATE)) AS early_arrival_duration FROM special_ot -- Lọc vi phạm: Mốc Bắt Đầu Chuẩn + OT > Giờ về thực tế + Phút đến sớm bù trừ WHERE CAST((std_start_datetime + NUMTODSINTERVAL(overtime_sum_hours, 'HOUR')) AS DATE) > (CAST(check_out_date AS DATE) + GREATEST(0, CAST(std_start_datetime AS DATE) - CAST(check_in_date AS DATE))) ),
-- ========================================== -- LUỒNG 3: GOM DATA & XUẤT BÁO CÁO (UNION ALL) -- ========================================== combined_violations AS ( SELECT * FROM normal_ot_target UNION ALL SELECT * FROM special_ot_target ) SELECT #{sessionId} , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , SYSDATE , 1 , 'KO16KSC5601' , 'OT Source' , 'Request No' , 'Employee No' , 'Full Name (English)' , 'Organization' , 'Grade Code' , 'Grade Title' , 'Grade Title Name' , 'Assignment Category' , 'Grade Type' , 'Date Retire' , 'Attendance Date' , 'Work Type Code' , 'Shift Type Code' , 'Early Leave Hours' , 'Tardy Hours' , 'Going Out Hours' , 'Input Reason' , 'OT Start Time' , 'Actual Check In' , 'Early Arrival Hours Credit' , 'Overtime Sum Hours' , 'Expected OT End' , 'Actual Check Out' , 'OT Violation Hours' FROM DUAL
UNION ALL SELECT #{sessionId} , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} , SYSDATE , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v.time_and_attendance_date, v.employee_no) + 1 , 'KO16KSC5601' , v.OT_SOURCE , v.request_no , v.employee_no , em.FULL_NAME_ENGLISH , em.ORG_NAME_LOCAL , em.grade , em.grade_title , (SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE', em.grade_title, NULL, 'en') FROM DUAL) , em.ASSIGNMENT_CATEGORY , em.GRADE_TYPE , TO_CHAR(em.date_retire, 'DD/MM/YYYY') , TO_CHAR(v.time_and_attendance_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') , v.work_type_code , v.SHIFT_TYPE_CODE , TO_CHAR(v.early_leave_hours) , TO_CHAR(v.tardy_hours) , TO_CHAR(v.going_out_hours) , v.time_attend_input_reason_desc , TO_CHAR(v.std_start_datetime, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') , TO_CHAR(v.check_in_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') , TO_CHAR(ROUND(v.early_arrival_duration * 24 , 1)) , TO_CHAR(v.overtime_sum_hours) , TO_CHAR(v.expected_ot_end_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') , TO_CHAR(v.check_out_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') , TO_CHAR(ROUND((CAST(v.expected_ot_end_time AS DATE) - (CAST(v.check_out_date AS DATE) + v.early_arrival_duration)) * 24 , 1)) FROM combined_violations v LEFT JOIN EMP_MASTER em ON v.employee_no = em.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER
